notes.title: Version 1.0.1: Final Boss Bugfix
notes.content: We have fixed a bug that occurs on the final boss.

notes.title: Localization into 12 LANGUAGES!
notes.content:
Mac Biskwi Adventures is localized into 12 languages!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39671203/75e64439a8ef26ce027cf5cb825f6fa1990e348c.png[/img]

Here's the list of the supported languages:

- English
- French
- Portuguese
- Spanish
- Italian
- German
- Russian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Simplified Chinese
- Traditional Chinese
- Indonesian

Don't see your language here? Please, feel free to get in touch with us via Twitter DM and we'll do our best to include your language.

Don't be shy, we're friendly! :-)

Our social media accounts:

https://twitter.com/MacBiskwi
https://www.instagram.com/macbiskwi/
https://www.facebook.com/macbiskwiadventures

notes.title: NEW RELEASE DATE!
notes.content:
Mac Biskwi Adventures has a new release date and we're more than happy to share it with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39671203/038bc0b77d8de9316af55836004754a849bae6d8.png[/img]

Our game will be released on September 2022! We're working hard to make it happen and hopefully, you'll enjoy the game as much as we do.

Make sure to wishlist the game so you won't miss our release date!

Thanks,

DigitalFox team
